title: Make a lambda that adds 5
description: Make a one-line lambda that adds 5 to a number. Call it and print the answer.
solution:
add = lambda a, b: a + b
print(add(4, 5))

title: Keep even numbers with filter
description: Make a list of numbers. Use filter() and lambda to keep only even numbers. Print the result.
solution:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
evens = list(filter(lambda n: n % 2 == 0, numbers))
print(evens)

title: Double numbers with map
